title: Gallai Decomposition of Ordered Groups: Subgroups, Quotients, and the $N$-free Case
summary: We study Gallai decomposition for groups equipped with two-sided invariant partial orders. The key algebraic step extends to arbitrary binary relations compatible with the group operation: if all left and right translations preserve a binary relation $ρ$, then every least strong module $S_ρ(\e,g)$, $g\ne\e$, is a subgroup. For a partial order this subgroup is convex. Thus the robust modules through the identity of an ordered group form a canonical chain of convex subgroups, with each canonical factor $H/H^-$ prime, totally ordered, or equality-ordered.
